summary: AdHocQuery is used to generate HTML tables from database query results, converting SqlDataReader output into a formatted HTML string for display purposes.
purpose: To provide dynamic HTML table generation from database queries for flexible and ad-hoc data presentation.

workflows.name: HTML Table Generation Workflow
steps: Execute SQL query and retrieve data using SqlDataReader.
Format data into HTML table rows.

system_behavior: Converts SQL query results into HTML format strings.
